palette.notes: Frames: warm wood oranges and browns indoors, saturated greens outdoors, teal water; shadows go darker brown/orange, not grey. Mines drop to dark warm browns lit by a lamp. UI is cream/orange wood too.

lighting: Warm and soft: lamp glow in the mines, window light in the saloon, evening campfire in fan art. Little cast shading on sprites; mood comes from the scene's overall colour.
silhouette: Chunky big-head sprites about two heads tall with a bold hat or hair shape (pink beanie, blue hair) as the identifier; portraits use a strong hair mass and a dark outline.

motion.timing: Not measured. Sprites use short walk cycles and small gestures; fan animation of the style cuts between still portraits and small moving sprites.

texture: Tile-based wood planks, grass with scattered flowers and clumps, water with light ripples. Portraits have soft blush and cluster shading, higher resolution than sprites.
camera: Top-down 3/4 view following the farmer; dialogue and menus overlay the scene. Fan edits cut from small sprite shots to full-frame portraits.
sound: Light, relaxed score that changes with seasons and weather.

acting.enters: Villagers walk in on daily routes; in fan animation the character pops in large as a portrait, then is shown small in the room.
acting.acts: Sprite does a simple gesture with an emote bubble (speech, heart); feelings live in the big portrait (blush, closed-eye smile, hands on cheeks).
acting.exits: Walk off along their route or through a door; the world keeps going.
acting.depth: Cuts between scales rather than layers: tiny sprite behind a bar counter, then a close-up portrait; fan art adds a floating mini-character beside a big portrait.

techniques: portrait cut-in for emotion while the sprite stays simple
emote bubble above the sprite (heart, speech, question)
warm brown shadows instead of grey
bold hat or hair shape as the character's identifier
pixel heart and sparkle pops around a happy portrait
feel: warm wood palette + chunky big-head sprites + portrait cut-in for feelings = cozy readable world
for_fred: Keep Fred's sprite simple and cut to a big portrait close-up for the emotional beat (closed-eye smile, blush, pixel hearts), then back to small Fred walking his route. Let Pixie float in as a mini sprite beside Fred's big portrait.
